Animate.Name: Animate Time Changes
Animate.Hint: Run the clock, turn the wheel and move the moons through a change of time, rather than jumping straight to the new time.

SeasonTrim.Name: Dress the Frame for the Season
SeasonTrim.Hint: Trim the calendar's frame for the season, for everyone: frost and icicles in winter, a flowering vine in spring, sunflowers in summer, and fallen leaves in autumn.

SceneDarkness.Name: Darken Scenes at Night
SceneDarkness.Hint: Keep the active scene's darkness in step with the sun: dark at night, light by day, darkening through the hour after sunset and lightening through the hour before sunrise. Scenes with their darkness locked are left alone.

SeasonalDaylight.Name: Long Summer Days
SeasonalDaylight.Hint: Move sunrise and sunset with the seasons: sixteen hours of daylight at midsummer and eight at midwinter. D&D 5e's dawn and dusk recovery, the day wheel and the scene's darkness all follow.

Enable.Title: Turn On the Calendar?
Enable.Content: Simple D&D Calendar shows D&D 5e's calendar, which is turned off in this world. Turn it on now? You can change this later under Game Settings → Configure Calendar.
Enable.Recovery: With the calendar on, D&D 5e recovers daily, dawn and dusk item uses as time passes rather than on a long rest, unless its Daily Recovery Mode says otherwise.
